meta.description: @fzlt/core/dice: Seeded dice for tabletop games. API and measured size (4262 B gzip).

leadHtml:
DICE V0.27.0 ALPHA

@fzlt/core/dice

Seeded dice for tabletop games. roll(seed, n, sides) gives the values; dice() also builds a short tumble for each d6 (positions and orientations over time) that lands on the value the seed picked, so every player who rolls the same seed sees the same roll. - The values come from integer maths only (a 32-bit hash generator): the same seed gives the same values in every browser. The tumble is made to end on them (it is not a physics run that might land on an edge), so the face that lands up is the value by construction. The tumble is the look and never feeds a result: it keeps the builtin Math.sin, cos, acos and **, whose last bit may differ between engines (a path may differ in its last bits; the values never do), so an online sim reads value, never path. - The path is data: path holds frames samples per die of [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] (y up, the centre's height over the floor, a unit quaternion), and pose(i, t, out) reads it at any time. - dioramaDice builds the dice into an @fzlt/core/diorama scene (a chamfered body, pips painted on the faces that look at the camera) and shows them at a time; popDome puts them under a clear dome that you press: they jump, tumble and land. No allocation per roll, pose or show in the steady state (typed arrays, fixed capacity). Distances on the floor use steer's exact hypot (the builtin boxes its arguments).

rest.html:
IN SHORT
roll(seed, 2, 6, out); // the values alone: integer maths, the same in every browser
const dc = dice({ count: 2 }); // d6 with tumble paths that land on those values
const v = dioramaDice(d, dc, { on: "table" }); // into a @fzlt/core/diorama scene, pips painted
dc.roll(matchSeed + turn, { from: [-4, 0] }); // both players: the same seed, the same roll
v.show(t); // each frame, t seconds since the roll; dc.value → [3, 5]

API

DiceOptions interface ALPHA

Options for dice(): how many, their size and the tumble's length and sample rate.

export interface DiceOptions {
    /** Dice rolled at once (default 1; `n` can change up to `cap` between rolls). */
    count?: number;
    /** The most dice (default `count`). */
    cap?: number;
    /** Edge length in world units (default 1). */
    size?: number;
    /** Seconds from the throw to rest (default 1.4). */
    duration?: number;
    /** Samples per second in `path` (default 60). */
    rate?: number;
}

ThrowOptions interface ALPHA

How roll throws: from where to where, how high, how far apart; or a pop from rest.

export interface ThrowOptions {
    /** Where the throw starts, [x, z] on the floor (default [−4 × size, 0] from `to`). */
    from?: ArrayLike<number>;
    /** Where the dice land, [x, z] (default [0, 0]). */
    to?: ArrayLike<number>;
    /** How high the dice start over where they rest (a throw), or how high they jump (a pop); default 2.5 × size. */
    height?: number;
    /** Space between the dice across the throw (default 1.7 × size). */
    spread?: number;
    /** Each landing spot moves up to this far, seeded (default 0.35 × size). */
    jitter?: number;
    /** Full forward rolls on the way (default: by the distance; at least 1). */
    turns?: number;
    /** A pop: each die jumps from where it rests (the last roll's landing), straight up. */
    pop?: boolean;
}

dice function ALPHA

A set of d6 with tumble paths: roll(seed, throw) fills value and path; pose(i, t, out) reads die i at t seconds. Between rolls the dice rest where they landed.

export declare function dice(o?: DiceOptions): {
    /** Dice in the next roll (1..cap). */
    n: number;
    cap: number;
    size: number;
    duration: number;
    rate: number;
    /** Samples per die in `path`. */
    frames: number;
    /** Die i, frame f at (i × frames + f) × 7: x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw. */
    path: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** The value each die shows (1..6). */
    value: Int32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** The sum of the last roll. */
    total: number;
    /** Roll `n` dice from `seed`: values as `roll(seed, n, 6)`, and their tumbles. Returns the total. */
    roll(seed: number, t?: ThrowOptions): number;
    /** Die i at t seconds since the roll: out = [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw]. False once it rests. */
    pose(i: number, t: number, out: {
        [i: number]: number;
    }): boolean;
};

Dice type ALPHA

What dice returns.

export type Dice = ReturnType<typeof dice>;

DioramaDiceOptions interface ALPHA

Options for dioramaDice: what they rest on, the cluster to sort in, colours and shadow.

export interface DioramaDiceOptions {
    /** The id of the object they rest on (the floor, a tray): `path` is from its top centre. */
    on: string;
    /** Their ids are `${id}0`, `${id}1`, … (default "die"). */
    id?: string;
    /** The cluster they sort in (default the parent's own, "@" + on). */
    cluster?: string;
    /** Body colour (default `#f6f1e7`). */
    color?: string;
    /** Pip colour (default `#1d1b22`). */
    pip?: string;
    /** Blob shadow strength (default 0.3). */
    shadow?: number;
}

dioramaDice function ALPHA

Build dc's dice into diorama d: per die a group (moved and turned by show) holding a chamfered body, and its pips painted in the depth sort on each face that looks at the camera. show(t) poses every die at t seconds since the roll (dice past dc.n are hidden); true while any still moves. Call it before d.draw().

Options for popDome: where it stands, how big, its colours.

export interface PopDomeOptions {
    /** The id of the object it stands on. */
    on: string;
    /** Its ids start with this (default "dome"): the plinth is `${id}`, the dice `${id}-die0`, … */
    id?: string;
    /** Where on the parent's top, [x, z] (default [0, 0]). */
    at?: ArrayLike<number>;
    /** The dome's radius (default 2.6 × the dice's size × √cap). */
    radius?: number;
    /** The plinth's colour (default `#d8473b`). */
    color?: string;
    /** The glass tint (default `#cfe8ff`). */
    glass?: string;

    cluster?: string;

}

popDome function ALPHA

dc's dice under a clear dome on a plinth: press(seed) pops them (the dome dips, the dice jump, tumble and land on the values roll(seed, n, 6) gives) and returns the total; show(t) poses the dome and dice at t seconds since the press, true while it moves.
